segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the calibration renewal and the 18 additional technician seats you asked about for the Ohio and Indiana labs.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We are at 42 seats today, and if this goes through we'd need 60 total by February 12. The main question is whether the price holds if procurement takes until month-end.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It does, through January 31. The quote I have is $48,600 annually for the platform, plus $7,200 for the onsite instrument mapping, so $55,800 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the onsite work is still two days? We cannot have the pressure bench team offline longer than that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, two days. One day for the gauge and torque inventory, one day for the environmental chambers and certificates. We would target February 19 and 20 if that lines up.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That should work. I did email yesterday about the invoice split, though. We need software billed to corporate and services billed to the Fort Wayne cost center.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, I saw it, and sorry I was slow there. Honestly my whole day got swallowed by admin stuff: typing updates into the CRM, fixing duplicate account records in the database, and building the internal order packet for deal desk. I had like one actual buyer call before 3 p.m., which is not ideal. But I did get your split-billing note into the paperwork, so the billing tool should generate two invoices.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. As long as the paperwork shows separate POs, we're fine. Corporate PO is 77184, Fort Wayne is 33902.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect, I have 77184 for the subscription and 33902 for the onsite services. Term is February 1, 2026 through January 31, 2027, net 30, annual payment.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Send the order form today and I'll route it. If legal doesn't redline the data clause again, I think we can sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I'll send the clean order form in the next hour with the pricing sheet attached and the February go-live dates noted.
